critical_code_review_comments: gst_router._is_intra() defaults to True (CGST+SGST) when seller state code or buyer GSTIN cannot be determined — this matches the 'B2C / no GSTIN' use case which is correctly intra-state for the seller. Reasonable default.

gst_router uses invoice_date $lte '{month}-31' as a string-range filter — works for ISO YYYY-MM-DD dates but assumes dates are stored as strings, not datetime. Confirmed by data layout. Edge: Feb / 30-day months — still returns correct results because no actual Feb 31 exists.
sales_router.invoice_pdf streams a freshly built PDF on every request (no caching). Acceptable for small invoices, but consider caching by invoice_id+updated_at for high-volume tenants.
sales_router.share_links: when party has no phone, falls back to https://wa.me/?text=... (no number) — matches spec; user can manually pick the recipient inside WhatsApp.

POS.jsx 'paid' input defaults to 0 and falls back to totals.grand at checkout — fine for cash-paid flows, but stock is still deducted regardless of payment status (balance_due is tracked separately). This is correct retail behavior.

CompanySwitcher.jsx does window.location.reload() after switch — heavy but safe (forces all pages to refetch with new active_company_id). Could be replaced with a global cache invalidation but reload is defensible for an MVP.

pdf_invoice.py _is_interstate uses state code map; same logic duplicated in gst_router._is_intra (different semantic: interstate vs intra). Consider extracting to a shared util in db.py or a new states.py to avoid drift.

register endpoint creates company only when business_name is provided. Backend test had to be adapted to use 'business_name' (not 'company_name') — frontend Register.jsx already matches. Confirmed wire-compatible.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suites to run: `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v` runs all 3 files = 48 tests. Key API contract details discovered: (1) /api/auth/login returns {access_token, token_type, user} — NOT 'token'. (2) /api/auth/register requires field name 'business_name' (NOT 'company_name'). (3) /api/subscription/create-order body field is 'plan_id' (NOT 'plan'). (4) PDF tenant isolation: an authenticated user with NO active company gets 400 (not 404) because require_company short-circuits before the invoice lookup — both are valid 'isolation holds' outcomes. (5) GST month filter uses string range invoice_date $gte 'YYYY-MM-01' / $lte 'YYYY-MM-31'. (6) Sales list returns invoices sorted by created_at DESC, so the POS-00001 created by frontend test is row 1 (visible in screenshot). System clock on preview env is 2026-06-28, so default GST month is 2026-06.
rca_of_the_issue: No issues found. Iteration 4 implementation is correct end-to-end. All 4 new features (GST reports, PDF + share, multi-company switcher, POS billing) work as specified at both API and UI layers, and no prior iteration regressed.
